title: Game protocol 228
summary: Evidence of game protocol number 228 across releases. A shared number does not prove compatible packet formats.
description:
Evidence is temporarily grouped by game protocol number. Release, branch and region associations preserve source context without asserting an identical packet contract. Separate variants will be added when packet-level differences have been established.

The research includes additional technical evidence for this association. Its level is an emulator configuration or publication, not validation of an official client.
